verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio explicitly offers a Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator and other early-stage forms, positioned as a self-service resource for founders at all stages, with community corroboration (HN commenters praising Orrick's startup docs and comparing them favorably to Gunderson Dettmer's set, and one founder describing using them to incorporate). This demonstrates a stated, well-documented early-stage financing practice with published forms/tools specifically covering convertible instruments. Missing for 10: no dedicated published explainer specifically naming SAFEs (as opposed to convertible notes), and no independent legal-press ranking specifically for seed-stage financing work.
